parakeet: Five, God answers in his own time. Oh, how convenient. This was our convenient escape hatch when prayer didn't work. If someone prayed for healing and didn't get it, God's timing. If they died, well, we don't understand his ways. No matter what happened, no matter what happened, the answer was always the same. God's mysterious timing. It's a never ending cycle of mental gymnastics designed to protect the idea that God is listening, even when all the evidence suggests that he isn't. Number four, you can't be good without God.
